caption: Greek settlers found Byzantion on the hill above the Golden Horn.
A walled trading town on the sea road to the Black Sea.
Septimius Severus rebuilds the city and begins a great hippodrome.
Constantine makes the city his new capital.
title: NEW ROME

caption: An aqueduct brings water across the hills.
New land walls guard a city of hundreds of thousands.
Hagia Sophia rises over the largest city in Christendom.
title: THE GOLDEN AGE

caption: Plague, war and siege have emptied whole quarters.
Trade fills the harbours of the Golden Horn again.
Crusaders rule a looted and half-burnt city.
The Byzantines win back their capital, but cannot rebuild it all.
A shrunken city of villages and gardens inside the old walls.
Mehmed II makes the conquered city the Ottoman capital.
title: THE FALL

caption: 447: an earthquake brings down the new land walls; they are rebuilt within months.
1203-1204: crusader fires burn whole districts of the city.
1453: the Ottoman army camps before the land walls, its great guns firing day and night.
